Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
Kestrel Avionics Systems

Role summary

Kestrel Avionics designs flight-control and sensor systems for unmanned aerial platforms. We are seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer in Waterloo to own firmware for our next-generation flight controller.

Responsibilities

- Architect, implement, and maintain real-time firmware in C and C++ on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers
- Develop and tune RTOS-based task scheduling (FreeRTOS or Zephyr)
- Write and debug device drivers: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN bus, PWM
- Implement sensor-fusion pipelines (IMU, barometer, GNSS) with hard real-time constraints
- Own the bootloader, OTA update path, and flash-memory management
- Bring up new hardware with the EE team: schematic review, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes
- Lead DO-178C-aligned documentation and code-review practices; mentor two junior firmware engineers
- Define the firmware roadmap with the VP of Engineering

Required qualifications

- 7+ years of professional embedded firmware development in C/C++
- Strong production experience with ARM Cortex-M, RTOS internals, and interrupt-driven design
- Hands-on hardware bring-up and debugging with JTAG/SWD tooling
- Deep understanding of memory-constrained, hard real-time systems
- Experience with safety-critical development processes (DO-178C, ISO 26262, or IEC 61508)
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent

Nice to have

- Control-systems theory background (PID, Kalman filtering)
- Rust on embedded targets
- Experience managing offshore contractor teams

Compensation

$140,000-$170,000 CAD, on-site in Waterloo (lab access required), relocation support available.
